about: Turns today's OpenStreetMap into Saigon as of late 2009. Every entry gives its reason. Zones are painted before the OSM land use (OSM water and parks still win inside them); drop_roads_inside removes OSM streets lying wholly inside the zone unless named in keep_road_names. drop_minor_streets removes the zone's named side streets (major roads stay). repaint paints the zone's class over today's land use (water stays). keep_major_roads keeps the zone's trunk, primary and secondary roads (they were there in 2009; only the estate streets came later). drop_highway_classes leaves out every OSM way of those classes. drop_road_names match case-insensitively.
drop_highway_classes_why: no expressway reached the area in 2009: the HCMC - Long Thành - Dầu Giây expressway (with its Bà Dạt, Bà Hiện, Mương Kênh, Đỗ Xuân Hợp bridges and the Cát Lái ramps) opened in 2015
drop_road_names: Song Hành Xa Lộ Hà Nội
Lối vào Nhà để xe T3

drop_road_names_why.Mai Chí Thọ: the East-West avenue through Thủ Thiêm opened in 2011
drop_road_names_why.Phạm Văn Đồng: the Gò Vấp - Thủ Đức avenue opened in 2013
drop_road_names_why.Long Thành: the HCMC - Long Thành - Dầu Giây expressway opened in 2015
drop_road_names_why.Cầu Ba Son / Cầu Thủ Thiêm 2: the Ba Son bridge opened in 2022
drop_road_names_why.Vành đai 2: ring road 2 sections were built after 2010
drop_road_names_why.Võ Chí Công: the ring road 2 section through Phú Hữu opened after 2015
drop_road_names_why.Cầu Sài Gòn 2: the second Sài Gòn bridge, beside the 1961 one, opened in 2021
the service roads alongside Xa lộ Hà Nội (now Võ Nguyên Giáp) came with its widening for metro line 1 (2012-2015) and alongside the expressway (2015)
drop_road_names_why.Cầu Phú Hữu: carries ring road 2 (Võ Chí Công), after 2015
drop_road_names_why.Cầu Thị Nghè 2: the second Thị Nghè bridge opened about 2014 (from memory; the 1960s Thị Nghè 1 stays)
drop_road_names_why.T3 roads (Cầu vượt Ga T3, Ga đi / Ga đến: Tân Sơn Nhất's terminal 3, its flyover and the Trần Quốc Hoàn - Cộng Hòa link road (with the Phan Thúc Duyện underpass) opened 2024-2025
drop_road_names_why.expressway bridges and ramps (Cầu Mương: the expressway's frontage-road bridges and the Phú Hữu / Cát Lái interchange ramps, built with the expressway and ring road 2 after 2010

drop_way_ids_why: the trunk 'Cầu Bình Lợi' ways are the new road bridge carrying Phạm Văn Đồng over the Sài Gòn river (opened with the avenue, after 2009); the old Bình Lợi bridge's road lanes (the primary ways) stay

zones.name: Thủ Thiêm
zones.why: in 2009 the peninsula opposite District 1 was being cleared for the new town: marsh, creeks and a few old lanes; the grid streets came after 2010
zones.polygon_note: west and north edges along the middle of the river (measured from the OSM water), so District 1's own bank (Tôn Đức Thắng, Bến Bạch Đằng) and Bình Thạnh's ward 22 north of the bend (Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh, the Thủ Thiêm bridge's west end) stay city; the first versions reached across the river

zones.name: Quận 2 east and Quận 9 south
zones.why: in 2009 Bình Trưng, Thạnh Mỹ Lợi, Cát Lái and Phú Hữu were rice fields, shrimp ponds and canal villages along a few roads; the side-street grids are 2010s subdivisions

zones.name: Quận 9 around Suối Tiên
zones.why: east of Xa lộ Hà Nội the High-Tech Park was mostly empty lots in 2009 and the rest fields and villages

zones.name: Tân Cảng (now Vinhomes Central Park)
zones.why: until 2007 the Tân Cảng container port and navy land; in 2009 an emptied port yard. Vinhomes Central Park and Landmark 81 were built 2015-2018

zones.name: Ba Son shipyard (now Vinhomes Golden River)
zones.why: the Ba Son naval shipyard worked here until 2015; the towers came after

zones.name: Đảo Kim Cương
zones.why: the Diamond Island towers on the Quận 2 riverbank were built 2011-2018; in 2009 the spit was marsh

zones.name: Khu Công nghệ cao (Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
zones.why: set up in 2002, but in 2009 mostly cleared lots with a few plants (Nidec, Jabil; Intel's opened in 2010, Samsung's complex in 2016); the factory blocks and their side streets are later

zones.name: Tân Sơn Nhất terminal 3
zones.why: the third terminal, its aprons and access roads (2022-2025) south of the runways: in 2009 air-force land inside the airport fence

zones.name: Trần Quốc Hoàn - Cộng Hòa link
zones.why: the 2024 link road west of Phan Thúc Duyện through military land; in 2009 Phan Thúc Duyện ended at Thăng Long
